modern: The art of life is more like wrestling than dancing, in this respect: that it should stand ready and firm to meet attacks which are sudden and unexpected.
original: The art of life is more like the wrestler’s art than the dancer’s, in respect of this, that it should stand ready and firm to meet onsets which are sudden and unexpected.
